mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.brxx_id, h.zhid, z.zhmc AS zhxmmc, COALESCE(z.his_xmdm, '') AS zhxmdm, COALESCE(z.sfbz, 0) AS dj, 1 AS sl, h.sf, DATE_FORMAT(h.sfrq,'%Y-%m-%d') AS sfrq, h.czydm_sfr, h.zfbz, DATE_FORMAT(h.zfrq,'%Y-%m-%d') AS zfrq, h.czydm_zfr FROM bgxt_his_xm h LEFT JOIN bgxt_xmzh_zb z ON h.zhid = z.zhid WHERE h.brxx_id = #{brxxId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_his_xm (brxx_id, zhid, sf, zfbz) SELECT #{brxxId}, yq.zhid, 0, 0 FROM bgxt_yqxmzh yq INNER JOIN bgxt_brxx b ON b.brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND b.sb_djid = yq.sb_djid WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bgxt_his_xm ex WHERE ex.brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND ex.zhid = yq.zhid)

INSERT INTO bgxt_his_xm (brxx_id, zhid, sf, zfbz) SELECT #{brxxId}, zh.zhid, 0, 0 FROM bgxt_xmzh_zb zh WHERE zh.zhmc = (SELECT b.bgmc FROM bgxt_brxx b WHERE b.brxx_id = #{brxxId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bgxt_his_xm ex WHERE ex.brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND ex.zhid = zh.zhid) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_his_xm SET sf = 1, sfrq = NOW(), czydm_sfr = #{czydm} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND sf = 0
UPDATE bgxt_his_xm SET sf = 0, sfrq = NULL, czydm_sfr = NULL WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId} AND sf = 1
UPDATE bgxt_his_xm SET zfbz = 1, zfrq = NOW(), czydm_zfr = #{czydm} WHERE brxx_id = #{brxxId}
